# Code of conduct

OpenADLC follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
It applies to everyone taking part in the project — in issues, pull requests,
reviews, discussions, and anywhere else someone speaks for it — and to OpenADLC's
own bots as much as to people: a bot's words are the responsibility of whoever
runs it.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainers — today
[@orzelig](https://github.com/orzelig) — at conduct@620legal.com. GitHub has no
private messages, so email is the private channel; the security advisory form
is for vulnerabilities, not conduct, and a report sent there may be missed.

If your report is about a maintainer, write to legal@620legal.com instead. It
is read by someone at 620 Legal who is not a maintainer of this project, and
the maintainer concerned takes no part in deciding it.

Every report is reviewed and answered, and the reporter's identity is kept
private. The maintainers decide what follows, from a warning to a ban, as the
Covenant's enforcement guidelines describe.
